notes.title: Mini Update 64.3: Bug chase continues!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34177131/82bb7d75c62eb33a3775a0b33469e1814181f003.png[/img]
Hello everyone.

We are Live for two month and here is the changes and features coming to current build:
* Added feature - Fixed bugs with "null" dialog appearing while player skips the background slide
* Changed some UI images (butttons mostly)
* Increased game stability

At the moment we have registered many really annoying bugs in game ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/938350/discussions/0/3658515990062425494/]thanks to all contributors[/url]) and trying to fix them, adding saves and new dialogs in the same time. Tough times for FEG.

After May 1st, we are planning to start advertising about our game slowly, revealing our team to world, so [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/938350/discussions/0/3658515990062432005/]keep in touch[/url]!

Yours truly, Fatal Error Games team.

notes.title: Mini Update 64.2: Free timer, Re-Read, and more.
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34177131/82bb7d75c62eb33a3775a0b33469e1814181f003.png[/img]
We are Live for four weeks and here is the changes and features coming to current build:
[list]
[*] Added feature: Buttons Intro and Disaster to re-read last dialog and disaster now are shown at the left of game screen.
[*] Changes: Game time left until losing now always shown near the pause button, even if pause is not upgraded or unlocked yet.
[*] Fixed mistakes in steam page screenshots and several Disasters in-game. Thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561197994544499]Aquillion[/url]!
[*] Fixed bug that make a Game Mode background to disappear.
[*] Fixed bug that makes some SFX to play in wrong time and place.
[/list]

After two next weeks we are planning a Big Update, dont forget to check in!

With your help in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/938350/discussions/0/3658515990062425494/]Bug Reports Discussion[/url] we can catch and fix more glitches. You can also ask your game question in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/938350/discussions/0/3658515990062432005/]Live Talk Discussion[/url] and join us in Discord [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/938350/discussions/0/1798529872641231325/]in here[/url].

Yours truly, Fatal Error Games team.

notes.title: Mini update 64.1: Russian, sounds and more
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34177131/82bb7d75c62eb33a3775a0b33469e1814181f003.png[/img]
Two weeks passed from Early access and we have successfully implemented one of the most wanted features. But much more left to go. Here is the full list of changes and improvements:
[list]
[*] Added new Language: Russian. All content and interfaces translated accordingly.
[*] Added feature: Language selection in Settings menu.
[*] Added feature: Sound effects are now in beta-testing.
[*] Fixed bug: Every god now have its personal color of dialogs text, as planned.
[*] New content: 7 new Disasters for Zanna fans.
[*] Game directories cleaned of unused textures and images.
[/list]

With your help in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/938350/discussions/0/3658515990062425494/]Bug Reports Discussion[/url] we found some really nasty bugs, and fixing them step by step. You can ask your game question in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/938350/discussions/0/3658515990062432005/]Live Talk Discussion[/url] and also join us in social networks and Discord, links are [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/938350/discussions/0/1798529872641231325/]in here[/url].

Your truly, Fatal Error Games team.

notes.title: Divine Business Released on Steam!
notes.notes:
Well, actually it's Early Access Release. We want to make some more features until Full Release, and here is roadmap for game's life until it's done.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34177131/2e1c2e431dec71921e90fe602db8f96df7ccf8b9.png[/img]

As you can see, there would be three big updates, every six weeks per one, and we will also fix all bugs ASAP and make weekly patches for those purposes.

If you suddenly encounted a wild bug, report [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/938350/discussions/0/3658515990062425494/]in special discussion[/url]. If you have any other questions, you can share it on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/938350/discussions/0/3658515990062432005/]this discussion[/url], or make your own topic.

We will also make some concept arts and dev diary posts soon, if you want to know us better.

Stay in touch with FATAL ERROR GAMES team, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Game revealed in Steam!
notes.notes:
